homeHero.sceneNav: Choose the city: historic or contemporary

duomo.label: Cosenza Cathedral takes shape
duomo.title: Cosenza Cathedral
duomo.description: In the heart of the old town, the cathedral consecrated in 1222 holds more than eight centuries of history. From the three rose windows of its façade to the Madonna del Pilerio, step into one of Cosenza's defining places.

facts.title: 1222, before Frederick II
facts.text: The cathedral was consecrated on 30 January 1222 in the emperor's presence, after the rebuilding that followed the 1184 earthquake.

facts.title: The gift of the Stauroteca
facts.text: For the occasion Frederick II gave the city a precious reliquary cross, now kept in the Diocesan Museum.

facts.title: The Madonna del Pilerio
facts.text: Her chapel holds the twelfth-century Byzantine icon of Cosenza's patron saint.

ponte.label: The Calatrava Bridge takes shape
ponte.title: Calatrava Bridge
ponte.description: Designed by Santiago Calatrava, the San Francesco di Paola bridge crosses the Crati with a tilted white mast and a fan of cables: the contemporary face of Cosenza.

facts.title: A mast tilted at 52°
facts.text: The bridge hangs from a single steel element more than a hundred metres tall, rising obliquely into the sky.

facts.title: A harp over the Crati
facts.text: The cables fan out like the strings of a giant harp between the two banks of the river.

facts.title: Opened in 2018
facts.text: On 26 January 2018, eighteen years after the first design, the bridge stitched the Gergeri district back to the city.

mab.title: MAB – Bilotti Open-Air Museum
mab.description: Dalí, de Chirico, Manzù and Modigliani along Corso Mazzini: the MAB, a museum without walls.

mission.title: It welcomes, creates, connects
mission.text: Cosenza is not just a city to visit: it is a city to live in, one that welcomes, creates and connects. The “Cosenza Città Attrattiva” masterplan brings together retail, tourism, culture and craftsmanship to strengthen the city's identity, support local businesses and attract visitors, investment and new opportunities.
mission.carouselLabel: The three areas of Cosenza attrattiva

vive.title: Cosenza Vive
vive.text: City-centre shopping becomes an experience: market squares, themed routes such as the Food, Art and Crafts streets, and events that keep the city alive all year round.

connect.title: Cosenza Connect
connect.text: An organised, experience-led destination: cultural, roots and short-break tourism, with itineraries and experiences to discover the city and come back.

crea.title: Cosenza Crea
crea.text: Craftsmanship as an economic and identity driver: workshops spread across the old town, hands-on experiences and the “Made in Cosenza” brand.

crea.title: Made in Cosenza
crea.intro: Craftsmanship is one of the most authentic expressions of a community's identity: every workshop holds skills, traditions and creativity. Cosenza Crea wants to make it a lasting part of city life, integrated with retail, tourism and the old town.

ceramica.name: Ceramics
ceramica.text: Wheel, glazes and hand decoration. In Cosenza, worked clay gave its name to the Pignatari bridge, after the craftsmen who shaped terracotta pots.

legno.name: Wood
legno.text: Carving, turning and small furniture: a craft of time and skilled hands.

tessile.name: Textiles
tessile.text: Fabrics woven on the loom, from fibre to thread to pattern.

oreficeria.name: Goldsmithing
oreficeria.text: Precious metals worked by hand, in the city that called the first stretch of Corso Telesio “the street of merchants and goldsmiths”.

prodotti.name: Local produce
prodotti.text: The flavours of the territory, from kitchens to the wineries of Donnici.

crea.brandIntro: A brand for workshop products, so they become authentic souvenirs.

brand.title: Certified quality
brand.text: A selection of craftspeople and products, with shared rules.

brand.title: The story of the place
brand.text: Every product carries the story of its maker and where it comes from.

brand.title: Recognisable packaging
brand.text: A shared look, recognisable in the city and beyond.

crea.workshopsText: The programme plans a network of workshops in the old town, including in today's empty shops, that become stops on city routes and places to experience: workshops, demonstrations, meetings with craftspeople.
crea.workshopsTodo: The list of workshops will come from the Cosenza Crea register of craftspeople.
crea.quote: Craftsmanship is not a memory of the past. It is an economy that creates jobs, a heritage that shapes identity, an experience that makes a city unique.

roots.title: Return to Cosenza
roots.intro: Does your family come from here? Many families who left Cosenza now live in the United States, Canada and Argentina. Roots tourism helps you find records, homes and relatives, and plan your trip to the places of origin.
roots.other: La tua famiglia viene da Cosenza? Ti aiutiamo a ritrovare atti, case e parenti.
roots.stepsIntro: Four stages, from the first record to coming back.

steps.title: The search
steps.text: Names, dates and places rebuilt through records and archives.

steps.title: The family's places
steps.text: Houses, churches, quarters and villages your grandparents left.

steps.title: The community
steps.text: Meeting those who stayed and the city's everyday life.

steps.title: Coming back again
steps.text: A lasting bond between the city and its families around the world.
